protocol.purpose: combined Jacobian sensitivity and image-derived rotation-bank diagnostic
protocol.detector: WGSL structure-tensor score with deterministic spatial quotas; no learned detection weights passed
protocol.descriptor: learned compact 64-value DIC CNN; affine support sampled directly from the native target image in WGSL
protocol.rotation_bank_grid_deg: -180 to +175 degrees in 5-degree increments; nested uniform subsets provide 18 and 36 hypotheses
protocol.rotation_bank_selection: largest usable WGSL affine-consensus inlier count, then lowest residual; no analytic truth used for selection
protocol.candidate_policy: fixed detector-selected candidate coordinates; no analytic visibility masks; the repeatability denominator remains fixed across support hypotheses
protocol.residency_limit: WGSL descriptor extraction reads native pixels; descriptors are read to NumPy and uploaded for the existing WGSL mutual matcher, and retrieval diagnostic ranking uses NumPy
protocol.timing_optimization: resident prepared image, weights and reusable per-point workspaces; session setup counted once per point set
protocol.rotation_bank_residency: The coarse-to-fine path uploads each native image and CNN weights once, reuses per-point convolution workspaces across support hypotheses, and keeps descriptor vectors resident through the WGSL reciprocal matcher. Only compact reciprocal indices and scores are read before geometric consensus. The exhaustive rotation-bank diagnostic still reads descriptors for its per-query max-bank ranking.
